Name: (CP) Abigail's dream diet
Author: Gamerm3957YT
Description:
[b]Discription[/b]
This mod makes the following gemstones and artifacts heal you and give you energy when you eat them. -- Emerald Aquamarine Ruby Amethyst Topaz Jade Diamond Prismatic Shard, Quartz Fire Quartz Frozen Tear Earth Crystal, Alamite Bixite Fire Opal Helvite Jasper Malachite Obsidian Tigerseye Star Shards Hematite Fairy Stone Radioactive Ore

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]To install drag zip folder to your smapi mods folder unzip it in the mods folder delete the zip folder and press play[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Eating gems is now allowed :)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Smapi[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: The Gemstone Eater
Manifest.Description: Makes all gemstones edible for the player and adds a custom dialogue reaction for Abigail.
Manifest.Author: YourName
